dedupe_keys.name: mobilite comptages routiers grand poitiers donnees metiers

description: Mobilité - Comptages routiers - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The road traffic data concern about sixty counting points positioned on the main roads under the responsibility of Grand Poitiers Urban Community. The data allows to know the traffics (TMJO and TTMJA) as well as the average speeds. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Mobility - Road counts - Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trafic, vitesse. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
